full_page.content:
1935, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6
Page 6 Cont.
June 11 Novena ..... St. Ant ..... S.S. Sp Thanksgiving -- Easter made
Page 7
June 12 Rosemary Bader - 3 - no control of head or limbs .....
14 Clara Monart - 34 - husband & 2 small ch. went to a "healer" almost two yrs. ago .... fears ever since - fears "witch-Kraft".
15 Thedore
16 Al. Martin - 36 - now in Ford Hosp'l with badly bleeding tuomer, after six blood transfusions is enrolled in Ser. Mass As'n. Wife promised to Enroll perpetually if helpful .... June 22 Wife reports immediate im- provement at time of Enrollment - now out of danger. Deo Gr.
Mrs. Marie Barba - 58 - P. Stroke one yr. ago - still unable to talk. ....
Eleanore Schweder - 52 - cannot speak Margaret Mary Sullivan - 14 - bad weak spells.
Page 8 June 16 Jack Fr. McDonald - 10 - weak in memory .... could not speak till three yrs. old when folks made novena to little Fl. St. Therese.
John Kenny - two yrs. more to ordination - has badly infected finger. Alice Doherty - 19 - operation for appendicitis 2 yrs ago. Surprised Drs. at time. Pains, however, still continue - fever also keep up - Hopes to escape another operation.
Mary Madden - (47) wants house-work or day-work - 2700 Chestnut St. City.
Chas. McNeely & Ward Brothers
Mrs. Marie McNamara - has 3 little ones and husband & aged mother - sleepless-
Rose Cowara - 47 - physically, mentally & quite ..... mother not well - sister
